items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: We had a Mexican show... And that Mexican boy played that hard music... I don't see how the world he can do it.

ctx.x: He said, no, he can't read.

Well, how do you get all them licks and them beats and that music? Some of it was real hard, you know. Yeah. Yeah, it was real hard. He said, we taught it. And I mean, man, I knocked it out. I like it. I really like it. It's nice and it's beautiful. It's beautiful. It's nice music, yes indeed. And them trumpet players, oh man. Beautiful tone. What? Tones. Awesome. Yes indeed. We had a young trumpet player. We had a Mexican show, a flow show about four girls. And that Mexican boy played that hard music and I mean,…
I was surprised and a youngster.
